question: The theme of National Nurses Day 2025 was 'Our Nurses. Our Future. Caring for nurses strengthens economies'. When was this day celebrated in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**12 May**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **National Nurses Day** is celebrated annually to honor the contributions of nurses and their pivotal role in healthcare systems.
 
• The theme for **National Nurses Day 2025** was "**Our Nurses. Our Future. Caring for nurses strengthens economies**," emphasizing the importance of nurses in building resilient healthcare systems and driving economic growth.
 
• In **India**, National Nurses Day is celebrated on **May 12** every year. This date coincides with the birth anniversary of **Florence Nightingale**, the founder of modern nursing.
 
• The date mentioned in the question, "**Tue May 12 2026 00:00:00 GMT+0530 (India Standard Time)**," refers to the observance of National Nurses Day in **India** for the year 2026. Hence, this option is correct.
 
• The event serves as a platform to recognize and appreciate the dedication and selflessness of nurses in improving public health and ensuring patient well-being.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Florence Nightingale:**

 
 
• Born on **12 May 1820**, Florence Nightingale revolutionized nursing practices and established nursing as a professional discipline.
 
• Her work during the **Crimean War** (1853–1856) highlighted the importance of sanitation, hygiene, and patient care in hospitals.
 
• She is often referred to as the "**Lady with the Lamp**" due to her nightly rounds caring for injured soldiers.
 
• Her efforts laid the foundation for modern nursing education and practices worldwide.
 
 
 
• **Significance of National Nurses Day:**
 
 
• The day is observed globally to recognize the indispensable role nurses play in healthcare delivery and community welfare.
 
• It aims to raise awareness about the challenges faced by nurses and advocate for better working conditions, training, and career opportunities.
 
• Events such as workshops, seminars, and award ceremonies are organized to celebrate the achievements of nurses.
 
 
 
• **Role of Nurses in Healthcare:**
 
 
• Nurses are responsible for patient care, health education, disease prevention, and post-treatment recovery.
 
• They act as intermediaries between patients, doctors, and other healthcare professionals.
 
• During crises such as the **COVID-19 pandemic**, nurses played a critical role in frontline healthcare services.
 
 
 
• **India's Nursing Workforce:**
 
 
• India has a robust nursing workforce, with approximately **3.07 million registered nurses**, according to reports.
 
• The government has implemented various initiatives to improve nursing education, such as establishing nursing colleges and training institutes.
 
• Programs like the **National Health Mission** emphasize the integration of nurses into community healthcare services.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Other Observances Related to Healthcare:**

 
 
• **World Health Day:** Celebrated on **April 7** each year to commemorate the founding of the **World Health Organization** (WHO).
 
• **International Day of the Midwife:** Observed on **May 5**, focusing on the contributions of midwives to maternal and newborn health.
 
• **World Mental Health Day:** Observed on **October 10**, raising awareness about mental health issues and promoting mental well-being.
 
 
 
• **Key Government Initiatives in Nursing:**
 
 
• The **Indian Nursing Council** regulates nursing education and practice in India, ensuring high standards of care and training.
 
• Programs like the **Skill India Initiative** aim to enhance the skills and employability of nurses.
 
• Efforts to improve healthcare infrastructure and increase the nurse-patient ratio are ongoing under schemes like the **Ayushman Bharat** program.
